analytics_events_device.name: analytics_events_device
analytics_events_device.value: device IS NULL OR device IN ('mobile', 'desktop')

issues_resolution.name: issues_resolution
issues_resolution.value: (status = 'open') = (resolved_at IS NULL AND resolved_by IS NULL)

message_flags_reason.name: message_flags_reason
message_flags_reason.value: report_reason IS NULL OR report_reason IN ('abusive', 'spam', 'other')

profiles_min_tip.name: profiles_min_tip
profiles_min_tip.value: min_tip_minor IS NULL OR (min_tip_minor >= 100000 AND min_tip_minor % 100 = 0)

profiles_tip_presets.name: profiles_tip_presets
profiles_tip_presets.value: tip_presets_minor IS NULL OR cardinality(tip_presets_minor) BETWEEN 1 AND 4

profiles_tip_presets_range.name: profiles_tip_presets_range
profiles_tip_presets_range.value: tip_presets_minor IS NULL OR min_tip_minor <= ALL (tip_presets_minor)

tip_quotes_amounts.name: tip_quotes_amounts
tip_quotes_amounts.value: tip_minor > 0 AND platform_fee_minor >= 0 AND provider_fee_minor >= 0 AND recipient_net_minor > 0
